invoicingInstructions: Attach a copy of this PO to the invoice. Include the ship's captain's signed, stamped, and dated acknowledgement in the delivery note.
Include complete bank account and remittance details, including the SWIFT code, on the invoice to support timely remittance.
Supply superior-quality items as quoted to IMPA marine standards, supported by the manufacturer's guarantee.
All items are subject to approval and acceptance by the ship's master.
Include the asbestos-free certificate with the invoice.
Invoice only to the address indicated in the invoicing details.
Attach a copy of this PO and the goods delivery receipt to the invoice.
otherInstructions: Our company supports environmentally safe, biodegradable products. We encourage reduce, reuse, minimise, and recycle. Packaging materials must be environmentally sound and recyclable.
The vessel will return packing crates, delivery containers, and dunnage to you. Please collect them after delivery for reuse or recycling.
Where applicable, include the MSDS or test certificate with the goods supplied.
General-use detergents and soaps must be phosphate-free.
Attach manufacturer or class-approved certificates for applicable items to the delivery note.
Do not supply asbestos or asbestos-based material.
Subcontracted services are entirely at the vendor's risk.
The vendor is fully liable for any loss to the vessel, owners, or managers resulting from a subcontractor's negligence or wilful misconduct.
Provide class or maker certificates for lifting equipment, including wires, ropes, slings, shackles, chain blocks, and eyebolts.
Minimise additional costs. Endeavour to supply during normal working hours and avoid overtime.
As agents only for and on behalf of: {companyName}.
